verdict.rationale: Granola's docs confirm a mobile app for recording AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings and iOS calls, and separate docs confirm workspace-wide search/chat over meeting notes, but no evidence explicitly ties mobile-captured notes into the same searchable workspace pipeline. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that mobile-recorded notes/transcripts sync into the same workspace and are searchable via Chat/API alongside desktop notes, and any hands-on user report validating this integration.
